item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 08/Aug/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring persistently very hot weather to southern China in the next few days. Under the influence of a southwesterly airstream, it will be cloudier over the coastal areas during the weekend and early next week. An upper-air disturbance is expected to bring a few showers to Guangdong midweek next week. Besides, the broad area of low pressure will linger over the seas east of Taiwan in the next couple of days, bringing unsettled weather to the region.
